source: Daedalus Sky Director (GetWind, GetWetness, GetHour / night mask) + caldera heat zone + Great Forge Glow score (livestock.json production_budget.win_meter.score_0_100)
note: Data contract only. To be applied on a future Hephaestus editor turn into the forge, basalt, ash, herb and hot-spring MIDs. No Unreal write from this file alone. Status per binding: 'exists' = asset already created by heph_island_ue.py; 'planned' = MID to create on the apply turn.

HeatShimmer.rule: 1.0 inside caldera_forge heat zone, falls off linearly to 0.2 at 120 m; x(1-0.5*Wetness) when raining
drives: air refraction / heat distortion over caldera
thirst UI cue strength (caldera x2 drain)

AshFall.rule: 0.25 + 0.55*WindStrength in ash_fields; rain settles ash: x(1-0.7*Wetness)

MagmaPulse.rule: 0.5 + 0.5*sin(2*pi*t/6s); amplitude scaled by (0.3+0.7*TemperGlow) so a cold forge barely breathes

QuenchSteam.rule: set 1.0 on a quench dip at Prop_ForgeQuenchTub_Basalt, exponential decay half-life 4s

NightForge.rule: smoothstep dusk: 0 at hour 18, 1 at hour 21; reverse at dawn 5->7 (same mask as OddsReaper NightMask)

TemperGlow.rule: Great Forge Glow score_0_100 / 100 (livestock.json production_budget.win_meter); 1.0 only when score == 100 (tempered)
drives: Great Forge tempered look (iron colour shift dull->cherry->straw)

bindings.apply_note: needs a parent with Emissive/Opacity/Roughness params on the apply turn; BasicShapeMaterial cannot take these

bindings.TemperGlow: emissive colour = ForgeTint lerp; Metallic 0.9, Roughness 0.55 - 0.25*TemperGlow

bindings.applies_to: Prop_Forge*_Basalt (anvil, bellows, quench tub, chimney, altar, brazier, magma pool, vent plume)

bindings.HeatShimmer: wilt hue only for Steamreed/Boilbalm when unwatered
